LanguageData.QJ_SettingsEnabledNote: Toggle applies to the loaded save. Disabling restores all items to vanilla and discards this save's Quality Jobs configuration. If the mod stays installed, it re-activates with default settings the next time the save is loaded — disable is intended as preparation for removing the mod.
LanguageData.QJ_DisableWarning:
Disabling restores all set-aside items to vanilla ownership and permanently discards Quality Jobs configuration for this save (bill conditions, stock caps). Saves made afterwards contain no trace of the mod, so this is the clean way to prepare for uninstalling.

Note: if you keep the mod installed, it will re-activate with default settings the next time you load this save.
